Trump 2-week ceasefire announced ~midnight ET. Pakistan brokered. Iran SNSC accepted (Mojtaba Khamenei approved). Talks Fri Islamabad. Lebanon NOT included.
Reliance bought 2 million barrels Iranian crude DIRECTLY — Mukesh Ambani's big power move before ceasefire.
Trump rejected initial 45-day ceasefire as 'not good enough.' Threatened 'whole civilization will die tonight.' Kharg Island struck.
Green Asha crosses (8th Indian LPG). Hormuz easing: 53 ships last week. Iraq exempted. Iranian FM Araghchi called EAM Jaishankar.
F-15E officer rescued from Iran mountains. Sea Bird (Iranian LPG, 44k MT) at Mangalore — first Iranian LPG to India in 7 years.
Green Sanvi crosses (7th Indian LPG, 46,650 MT) → Mumbai Apr 6. F-15E shot down over Iran. A-10 down near Hormuz.
CMA CGM Kribi (1st French ship) crosses. UAE: 500+ missiles intercepted total. Indian Foreign Sec joins 60+ nation Hormuz talks.
BW Tyr docks Mumbai (94,000 MT LPG). India supplies fuel to Bangladesh, Nepal, Bhutan, Sri Lanka, Maldives.
Pine Gas + Jag Vasant (Indian LPG, 92,612 MT) cross Hormuz.
Aramco Yanbu hit. Ras Laffan: $20B loss, 3-5yr repair. QatarEnergy force majeure.
Shivalik + Nanda Devi (Indian LPG) cross under Indian Navy escort — first carriers to break the blockade.
IRIS Dena torpedoed off Sri Lanka. 87 killed.

kitchen.note: Brent crashed 13% to $94.80 today on ceasefire. LPG cargoes flowing again. 8 Indian LPG tankers extracted. Sea Bird (Iranian LPG) at Mangalore. Reliance bought 2M barrels Iranian crude direct (Apr 7). 51 lakh cylinders delivered Mon (95% online). PIB: 30+ days stock, ZERO dry-outs throughout war. Prices likely to ease over 2 weeks as cargoes arrive.

Ras Laffan (17% of LNG capacity) still 3-5 years to fully repair. QatarEnergy force majeure may ease. Eurasia Group: 'months to repair refineries even with ceasefire.' India 60% gas from ME — long-term costs structurally higher. CNG/piped gas supply takes weeks to normalize even with ceasefire holding.

Brent at $94.80 = OMCs profitable again. Govt cut excise ₹10/L (₹13 to ₹3) but OMCs absorbed it. With Brent below $100, retail hike is OFF the table. Possible mild cut by month-end if Brent stays sub-$95. Mumbai ₹103.54.

Ceasefire restores supply. Restaurants reopening. Bengaluru cafes dropping 'Gas Crisis Charge.' Delhi commercial cap likely to lift. Bakeries resuming normal operations. Recovery faster than residential as commercial markets price more dynamically.
Govt cut excise ₹10 to 0/L; OMCs absorbed. Trucking costs stable. ₹2,500cr/year exposure per ₹1 rise neutralized. Mumbai ₹90.03. Ceasefire + Brent crash removes immediate hike pressure entirely.

Palm +5%, Sunflower +16%. Rupee strengthening below 92.50 = imports cheaper. Ceasefire eases shipping costs from Indonesia/Malaysia. Fertilizer 50% spike will take longer to unwind — Kharif costs still elevated.
400K tons Basmati stuck during war — now releasing as Hormuz reopens. Diesel costs stable. 30% of fertilizers transit Hormuz — reopening = Kharif crop relief. Onion ~₹50/kg holding.

IndiGo stock JUMPED 9-11% TODAY on ceasefire (top Nifty gainer). Brent at $94.80 = ATF costs easing fast. Surcharge expected to phase out within 2-3 weeks. Aviation index up 11%. GMR Airports, SpiceJet, Dreamfolks all up. Korean Air, Philippines normalizing.

military.t: 🟢 2-WEEK CEASEFIRE — Trump Suspends Strikes, Iran Accepts
military.d: Trump on Truth Social: 'COMPLETE, IMMEDIATE, and SAFE OPENING of Strait of Hormuz' in exchange for 2-week strike suspension. 'Double sided CEASEFIRE!' Iran SNSC accepted with new Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei's approval. Iran FM Araghchi: 'safe passage via coordination with Iran's Armed Forces.' US Defense official: ceasefire now in effect, US suspended all strikes.

military.t: 🇵🇰 Pakistan Brokered — Talks Friday in Islamabad
military.d: PM Sharif + Field Marshal Asim Munir convinced Trump to hold off 'destructive force being sent tonight.' Talks open Apr 10 Islamabad. VP Vance likely leading US delegation. Vance + Witkoff advised acceptance. Sharif: 'sagacious gesture, both parties displayed remarkable wisdom.' India quiet diplomatic backer (Jaishankar-Araghchi call earlier in week).

military.t: 🏦 RBI Held Rates at 5.25% — Wait and Watch
military.d: Sanjay Malhotra: 'Prudent to wait and watch.' Repo rate unchanged at 5.25% for second consecutive meeting. Neutral stance maintained. CPI FY27 projection: 4.6%. Home loan EMIs unchanged — borrowers save up to ₹13.9 lakh. RBI flagged West Asia as 'supply shock.' Banks net open positions still capped at $100M. With Brent crashing to $94.80, RBI now has room for future rate cuts if needed.

military.t: 🇮🇳 Reliance Bought 2 MILLION Barrels Iranian Crude (Apr 7)
military.d: Mukesh Ambani's 'big power move' before ceasefire. India now officially buying from USA, Russia, Iran, Australia simultaneously. Sea Bird (Iranian LPG, 44k MT) at Mangalore. Jaishankar-Araghchi call: 'India supports ongoing efforts to stop war.' 51 lakh LPG cylinders delivered Mon. 345 Indian fishermen returned. India = quiet winner of the war.

military.t: 🚢 Hormuz to be Tolled — $2M Per Ship by Iran-Oman
military.d: NYT: Iran-Oman jointly will charge $2 million per ship for Hormuz transit during 2-week ceasefire window. Funds earmarked for Iranian reconstruction. Trump: 'big money will be made... Golden Age of the Middle East.' Currently only ~5% of pre-war traffic flowing. 1,500+ ships waiting off Oman/UAE coasts. Reopening will take days, not hours.

military.t: ⚠️ Lebanon NOT in Ceasefire — Israel Strikes Continue
military.d: Netanyahu's office clarified: ceasefire does NOT cover Lebanon (contradicts Pakistan PM's earlier statement). Israeli airstrike on vehicle in Saida, Lebanon today (Apr 8). 1,530+ Lebanese killed since March 2 incl 130 children. Hezbollah did not sign on. Israeli officials 'skeptical' the broader ceasefire holds. Israel + UAE missile alerts early Wednesday — possible transition violations.

military.t: 🚢 Green Asha + 7 More — India's Full LPG Fleet Extracted
military.d: Green Asha (8th Indian LPG, first MID-SIZE gas carrier) crossed Apr 6. Reuters/LSEG/Kpler confirmed. Only Jag Vikram (Indian LPG) remains awaiting clearance — now much safer to extract during ceasefire window. India's energy pipeline fully secured BEFORE ceasefire. Strategic vindication. 60 days fuel stock. Zero dry-outs.

military.t: 🟡 F-15E Officer RESCUED (Sun Apr 5) — Hostage Crisis Averted
military.d: Colonel hid 36+ hours in mountain crevice in Khuzestan with pistol + tracking beacon. US commandos swarmed mountains, dropped bombs to clear area. CIA deception campaign. 'Seriously wounded but really brave' — Trump. First US aircrew recovery from enemy territory since Bosnia 1995. Removed POW crisis risk that almost derailed talks.

IAEA chief Grossi: strikes near operating Bushehr plant including one 250 feet away. 'A nuclear facility and surrounding areas should never be struck.' Rosatom evacuated 200 staff 'minutes before plant was hit.' 1 security guard killed. Bushehr now active war zone — but ceasefire halts further risk. Iran's 460kg of 60% enriched uranium remains a concern. Trump: 'will be perfectly taken care of.'

Iran SNSC: 'Iran achieved a historic victory by forcing the criminal US to accept its 10-point plan. The US has accepted Iran's control over the Strait of Hormuz, enrichment rights, and removal of all sanctions.' Major points: Hormuz protocol, sanctions lift, reconstruction, US base withdrawal, permanent end to war. New Supreme Leader Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei approved deal.

military.t: 🇮🇱 Israel Killed 2 IRGC Senior Commanders + Hit South Pars
military.d: Israel struck South Pars petrochemical plant (Asaluyeh). Killed 2 IRGC senior commanders + IRGC undercover unit leader. 4 killed in Israel by Iranian missiles (Haifa residential building). Tel Aviv 1,000+ protested defying wartime ban. Pope Leo, EU Costa pushed peace throughout.

nukes.name: Bushehr ☢️
nukes.info: IAEA: strikes 250ft from operating reactor. Rosatom evacuated 200 staff 'minutes before plant was hit.' 1 security guard killed. ~100 Russian staff remain. First operational reactor hit in any war. Spent fuel on site. Ceasefire halts further risk but perimeter still hot.

nukes.name: Natanz
nukes.info: Struck Mar 21 (2nd time). Underground halls damaged. Iran says no radioactive leakage. IAEA confirmed damage + enriched uranium still on site. Mountainous construction nearby may be intact (ISIS report). Centrifuges destroyed.

nukes.name: Isfahan
nukes.info: UCF (Uranium Conversion Facility) processes UF6 gas — feedstock for centrifuges. Missile complex destroyed in early strikes. Multiple buildings flattened. Recovery years away.

nukes.name: Arak
nukes.info: Heavy-water reactor at Khondab struck Apr 3 (Wikipedia/IDF confirmed). Plutonium pathway facility — key to potential weapons-grade route. IAEA monitoring. Reactor not yet operational at full capacity.

nukes.name: Fordow
nukes.info: Built into mountain near Qom. Designed to survive bunker busters. US claimed earlier strikes 'obliterated' enrichment, but DNI Gabbard later said 460kg of 60% enriched uranium still exists. Trump: 'will be perfectly taken care of' — may be part of negotiation. Impossible to verify without inspections.

nukes.name: Yazd (Ardakan)
nukes.info: Yellowcake plant struck Apr 3 (IDF/Wikipedia). Yellowcake is early-stage uranium processing — feeds enrichment pipeline. Damage limits Iran's ability to produce new feedstock for years.

nukes.name: Parchin
nukes.info: Nuclear weapon component testing facility near Tehran. Confirmed damage. Historical site of suspected weaponization research. IAEA had been denied access here for years.

nukes.name: Dimona (Israel)
nukes.info: Iranian missiles hit Arad + Dimona near Israel's Negev nuclear center. 100+ injured. IAEA: no damage to nuclear facility. First time area was targeted this war. Israel does not officially confirm Dimona's role.

cities.info: 1,800km downwind from Iran. 4-7 days transit at 500hPa. Bushehr/Natanz strikes raised baseline risk. NO national iodine prophylaxis program. Ceasefire halts further strikes but does not undo damage.
900km from Hormuz. Sea + Aramco fire particulates risk via Arabian Sea currents. JNPT port at risk. Coastal positioning = primary maritime exposure.
Closest Indian metro to Iran. Dual exposure vector (wind + sea). Jamnagar refinery uses Arabian Sea water. Industrial concentration amplifies risk.
Rajasthan acts as wind funnel for upper-atmosphere transport. Aramco smoke plumes potentially reach in 5-8 days. Inland but exposed to airborne vectors.
Southern Naval Command. Oil spill risk 15-25 days via Arabian Sea currents from any Hormuz incident. Backwaters ecology vulnerable.
Konkan coast. Fishing economy ₹4,000 cr exposed. Tourism collapsed during war — recovery uncertain even with ceasefire.
Indo-Gangetic plain trap. Inversion layers concentrate atmospheric particles. Indirect but persistent exposure.
IRIS Dena wreck 400km south — debris field in transit. East coast currents provide buffer. Lowest exposure of major metros.

assessment.headline: DAY 40, 1 PM IST. THE RELIEF RALLY IS REAL. Sensex +2,775 → 77,392. Brent crashed 13%. RBI held rates. India = the war's quietest winner.
assessment.body:
Indian markets delivered their biggest single-day gain in years today as the ceasefire took hold and oil crashed.

MARKET EXPLOSION:
• Sensex +2,775 (+3.71%) to 77,392
• Nifty +815 (+3.52%) to 23,938 — near 24,000
• Brent crude -13.24% to $94.80
• WTI -13.76% to $97.41
• Asian markets: Nikkei +5.28%, KOSPI +5.61%, Hang Seng +3.04%

SECTOR WINNERS:
• Aviation: IndiGo +9-10%, GMR Airports, SpiceJet, Dreamfolks all up to 11%
• L&T +7%
• Bajaj Finance/Finserv +4-5%
• Adani Ports/Adani Enterprises +5-6%
• Realty index +5%
• PSU + private banks +3-4%
• Auto +3-4%
• Tech Mahindra: only laggard

RBI MONETARY POLICY:
• Repo rate held at 5.25% (Sanjay Malhotra)
• 'Prudent to wait and watch'
• Neutral stance maintained
• CPI FY27 projection: 4.6%
• Home loan EMIs unchanged — borrowers save up to ₹13.9 lakh
• Banks net open positions still capped at $100M to defend rupee
• With Brent crashing to $94.80, RBI now has room for future rate cuts

INDIA — THE QUIET WINNER:
• 8 of 9 LPG carriers extracted BEFORE ceasefire (Green Asha last)
• Reliance bought 2 MILLION barrels Iranian crude DIRECTLY (Apr 7)
• India now officially buying from USA, Russia, Iran, Australia simultaneously
• Sea Bird (Iranian LPG, 44k MT) at Mangalore — first Iranian LPG in 7 years
• Jaishankar-Araghchi diplomatic call validated
• 51 lakh LPG cylinders delivered Mon (95% online), ZERO dry-outs
• 60 days fuel stock buffer never breached
• India supplied fuel to Bangladesh, Nepal, Bhutan, Sri Lanka, Maldives throughout
• 345 Indian fishermen returned from Iran
• Pakistan brokered with India as quiet diplomatic backer

CEASEFIRE FRAMEWORK:
• 2-week pause negotiated by Pakistan (PM Sharif + Field Marshal Munir)
• Trump suspended bombing campaign
• Iran's Supreme National Security Council accepted (new Supreme Leader Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei approved)
• Iran-Oman to JOINTLY charge $2 MILLION per ship for Hormuz transit (NYT) — funds for reconstruction
• Talks open Friday April 10 in Islamabad
• VP Vance leading US delegation; Witkoff also involved
• Trump on Truth Social: 'big money will be made... Golden Age of the Middle East'

THE FRAGILE PARTS:
• Lebanon NOT in deal (Netanyahu confirmed — contradicts Pakistan PM)
• Israeli airstrike on Saida, Lebanon TODAY (Apr 8)
• 1,530+ Lebanese killed since March 2 incl 130 children
• Hezbollah did not sign on
• Israel + UAE missile alerts early Wednesday — possible transition violations
• Israeli officials 'skeptical' broader ceasefire will hold
• Currently only ~5% of pre-war Hormuz traffic flowing
• ~1,500 ships waiting off Oman/UAE coasts
• Reopening will take days, not hours
• Iran's 460kg of 60% enriched uranium remains; Trump: 'will be perfectly taken care of'

WHAT TO WATCH:
1. First commercial ship through Hormuz under ceasefire (24-48 hrs)
2. Friday April 10: Islamabad talks begin
3. Lebanon — does it spread or stay contained?
4. Iran honoring '$2M per ship' tolling fairly
5. Whether Israel/Hezbollah finds parallel ceasefire
6. Iran's enriched uranium negotiation

After 40 days, India enters the post-war phase as the quiet winner. The strategic foresight from Day 1 — buying from all sides, negotiating with all parties, extracting the LPG fleet preemptively, maintaining the energy buffer, supplying neighbors throughout — has delivered the biggest single-day market gain in years. The relief rally is real.
